SEARCH
Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.search

Class SearchQuery.Builder

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.utils.search.SearchQuery.Builder
Enclosing class:
SearchQuery
public static final class SearchQuery.Builder extends Object
A mutable accumulator for SearchQuery. Setters return this for chaining; build() snapshots the current state into an immutable query. Null roots/patterns and non-positive caps are coerced to safe values so a partially-filled builder still produces a usable query.
